title: Finite-cover descent of local-image factorization
statement: For a morphism p:F→G of sheaves with Grothendieck abelian coefficients on a scheme’s small-etale site [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let (U_i→W) indexed by Fin n be a covering family and x:B→G(W). If every restricted map x|U_i factors through localImage(p,U_i) [def-weil-pbc-grothendieck-etale-local-image], then x factors through localImage(p,W). No compactness, projectivity, or presentability of B is assumed, and n=0 is allowed.

source.place: Tag 00WL (section-sheaves-injective), image subsheaf argument for epimorphisms. The construction using epimorphic source maps is an agent-written extension to arbitrary Grothendieck abelian coefficients.

proof.text: Let c be the cokernel of localImage(p,W)→G(W). If every restricted map actually lifts locally, compose those covering sieves using transitivity to make x locally liftable on W. Its image is a local-image member, so xc=0.

Induct on a finite set of cover indices whose local-lifting assumptions have been removed. To remove index i, apply local-image detection to x|U_i and xc. After a source map makes the ith restriction locally liftable, the induction hypothesis applies: all other local lifts are preserved by precomposition. The same induction works for every source map into B, which is exactly the quantification needed by detection.

Taking the full finite index set removes all assumptions and gives xc=0. The abelian monoLift universal property gives factorization of x through the local-image inclusion. If n=0, the starting case already has no assumptions.
